import importlib.util, json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
check = str(root / 'scripts/check-golden-argv.py')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cga', check)
C = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(C)
live = root / 'tests/fixtures/golden-argv'
assert C.manifest_errors(live) == [], C.manifest_errors(live)
assert (live / 'MANIFEST.json').read_bytes() == C.manifest_bytes(live)
ci = (root / '.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_text().splitlines()
for line in ('          fetch-depth: 0', '          CI: "true"', '        run: python3 scripts/check-golden-argv.py'):
    assert line in ci, line
def git(cwd, *a):
    return subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(cwd), '-c', 'commit.gpgsign=false', *a], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
def run(cwd, *a, ci=None):
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k != 'CI'}
    env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
    if ci:
        env['CI'] = ci
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, check, *a], cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
r = run(root, '--base', 'HEAD')
assert r.returncode == 0, (r.returncode, r.stderr)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    t = Path(tmp)
    fx = t / 'tests/fixtures/golden-argv'
    shutil.copytree(live, fx)
    git(t, 'init', '-q')
    git(t, 'config', 'user.email', 't@example.invalid')
    git(t, 'config', 'user.name', 't')
    git(t, 'add', '-A')
    git(t, 'commit', '-qm', 'base')
    base = git(t, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD')
    def commit(msg):
        (fx / 'MANIFEST.json').write_bytes(C.manifest_bytes(fx))
        git(t, 'add', '-A')
        git(t, 'commit', '-qm', msg)
    def expect(code, name):
        r = run(t, '--base', base)
        assert r.returncode == code and name in r.stderr, (code, name, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
    expect(0, '')
    for p in sorted(fx.glob('agy-v*.json')):
        p.write_text(p.read_text().replace('"30m"', '"60m"'))
    commit('same edit as the adapter')
    assert C.manifest_errors(fx) == []
    expect(1, 'agy-v1.json')
    git(t, 'reset', '-q', '--hard', base)
    (fx / 'codex-v2.json').unlink()
    commit('delete')
    expect(1, 'codex-v2.json')
    git(t, 'reset', '-q', '--hard', base)
    (fx / 'claude-v3.json').rename(fx / 'claude-v10.json')
    commit('rename')
    expect(1, 'claude-v3.json')
    git(t, 'reset', '-q', '--hard', base)
    for prov in ('agent', 'agy', 'claude', 'codex'):
        d = json.loads((fx / (prov + '-v9.json')).read_text())
        d['contract'] = 10
        d['historical'] = []
        for case in d['cases']:
            case['spec']['provider_contract_version'] = 10
        (fx / (prov + '-v10.json')).write_text(json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) + chr(10))
    (fx / 'README.md').write_text((fx / 'README.md').read_text() + 'Contract 10.' + chr(10))
    commit('contract 10')
    expect(0, '')
    p = fx / 'agy-v1.json'
    p.write_text(p.read_text().replace('"30m"', '"45m"'))
    expect(1, 'agy-v1.json')
    git(t, 'reset', '-q', '--hard', base)
    r = run(t)
    assert r.returncode == 0 and 'skipped' in r.stdout, (r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
    r = run(t, ci='true')
    assert r.returncode == 2, (r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
print('ok')
